evidence.observation: O2 rises from ~4.6 ppm baseline to 13.2 ppm during growth
Monotonic climb to 33.2 ppm over four events, ~7 ppm per 120 s
Ar flow steady at setpoint 100 sccm, so rise is not a purge-flow loss
Pressure steady ~760-761 Torr, T at setpoint, heater power nominal

args.missing_evidence: Whether O2 keeps rising or plateaus; an Ar flow-step or pressure-hold leak check to distinguish air ingress (seal leak) from an O2 sensor drift or outgassing transient
